variations.name: Focus Facets
variations.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: single icon exploration for kollens, a crypto KOL and wallet tracking product with an optical intelligence / lens identity.
Direction 21: FOCUS FACETS. Create a solid clipped-square prism body with four broad filled facets, separated by a few clean optical cuts gathering around one generous central rounded-diamond window. The overall mark has subtle focus-frame character but is a substantial filled symbol, never an outlined reticle. Exact fourfold rotation symmetry. Crisp clipped angular outer edges with small controlled corner fillets, smooth circular or Bézier curves for the central optical window and internal counter cuts. Compact, stable, precisely constructed geometry, large solid masses and balanced even clearances. Broad facets, few clear cuts; clear at 24 pixels.
Composition: a square canvas with plain flat charcoal #101113 background; one gold icon centered, around 60% canvas width, generous margins. ONE ICON ONLY. No text, no letters, no wordmark or extra elements.
Color/style: only perfectly flat solid gold #F9C932 on flat charcoal, absolutely crisp vector-like edges and uniform fills, professional geometric brand identity.
Avoid: K or any letter geometry, outlines, reticle, camera, wireframe, gradients, grain, texture, lighting, glow, shadows, 3D, cube, mockup, labels, border, extra ornament.

variations.name: Orbit Prism
variations.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: single icon exploration for kollens, a crypto KOL and wallet tracking product with an optical intelligence / lens identity.
Direction 22: ORBIT PRISM. Create two interlocking SOLID faceted prism faces forming a compact rising diagonal capsule or hexagon around one clear circular optical opening. Broad filled gold lobes, simple flat faces, prismatic angular shoulders with small precisely controlled corner fillets. The lobes suggest an orbital connection and tracking around a lens. Exact 180-degree rotational symmetry and clean mathematically balanced cuts. Strong solid mass with a few clear negative-space cuts. The opening is a generous clear circle and the surrounding outer outline is a compact angular diagonal capsule. Precisely structured original brand mark, clearly legible at 24 pixels.
Composition: square canvas with plain flat charcoal #101113 background, single gold icon centered at around 60% of canvas width, generous margins. SINGLE ICON ONLY, no letters, no text, no wordmark, no extra elements.
Color/style: perfectly flat gold #F9C932 only, uniform fills and crisp vector-like geometric edges on plain charcoal.
Avoid: K or any letter geometry, generic chainlink, bullseye, magnifier, camera, coin, 3D cube, outlined or wireframe logo, gradients, grain, texture, lighting, glow, shadows, 3D rendering, mockups, labels, extra ornaments.
